description.fun: Pheromosa is an elegant, model-like cockroach from the Ultra Desert, fast enough to dodge lightning, that seems to find our world dirty and avoids touching anything. Foes who face it are left dazed, as if struck by its beauty, perhaps because of pheromones unknown to science. A real cockroach found in Singapore was named Nocticola pheromosa after it in 2023.
description.guide: Pheromosa is a Bug- and Fighting-type Ultra Beast, codenamed UB-02 Beauty, resembling a slender, white cockroach. It is extremely fast and confuses opponents with its beauty and pheromones. It is a version counterpart to Buzzwole.
description.tagline: A dazzlingly beautiful cockroach that refuses to touch anything
